as_above.purpose: Apply CCR/QPhiD/QGC/AngleClock corrections to physics claims with receipts.
nonnegotiables: Do not commit PDFs or generated receipts
procedure_steps: Verify required rule spec files exist
If claims.latest.jsonl missing, stop with instruction to run extract and claims build
Pass-through: emit corrections.latest.jsonl with added scaffold fields
Compute sha256 for inputs+rules+output and write receipts

so_below.purpose_human: Scaffold to apply corrections; currently pass-through with receipts.
ux_notes: Requires prior stages: physics_extract_text.py then physics_claims_build.py
so_below.outputs_friendly: Writes corrections.latest.jsonl and updates corrections.ledger.txt (local receipts)
success_criteria: Claims input present or a clear error is shown
